title: Finite evaluation of the untransported projection word
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$, a morphism $a:X\to Y$, a compactification $c$, a normalized system model $m$ and a scalar specialization $s$ [lem-coef-system-projection-evaluation]. Fix $n\in\mathbf N$ and comparison data $e:\operatorname{FiniteEvaluation}(\ell,E,m,s,n)$ [def-coef-finite-pairing-evaluation-data]. For arbitrary $K\in D(R_X)$ and $N\in D(\mathcal Q_X)$, put $M=s.\operatorname{reduced}(K)$, $H=\rho_{0*}m.h(M,N)$, $B_K=\rho_{0*}m.b(M)$ and $K_n=K\otimes^L A_{n+1}$. Let $c_H:\operatorname{ev}_n H\simeq\operatorname{Res}_n e.\operatorname{finite}.h(K_n,N_n)$ be, in order, restriction evaluation, sections evaluation, e.hom, and the inverse-first-variable reduction-unit comparison. Let $c_N$ be restriction evaluation, sections evaluation and native support evaluation on $N$, and let $c_K$ be the same comparison on $M$ followed by support of the reduction-unit isomorphism. Then, writing $t_e$ for the integral tensor evaluation comparison, the following equality of actual derived morphisms holds:
$$\operatorname{ev}_n(m.\beta(M,N))\,c_N=t_e(H,B_K)\,(c_H\otimes c_K)\,e.\operatorname{finite}.\beta(K_n,N_n).$$
Here composition is in the displayed left-to-right order, and the finite beta is the scalar-balancing, symmetry, sections/proper/open projection and finite evaluation word of [def-coef-finite-projection-evaluation-data]. No full-system scalar-Hom transport occurs in this statement.

theorem finiteProjectionWord_evaluation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {a : X ⟶ Y} {c : Compactification a}
    {m : Model l E c} {s : ScalarSpecialization l E m} {n : ℕ}
    (e : FiniteEvaluation l E m s n)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X))
    (N : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E X) :
    let homComparison :=
      (restrictionEvaluation l E n).app (Model.h (s.reduced K) N) ≪≫
        (finiteDerivedRestriction l E n).mapIso
          (e.sectionsX.derived.app (Model.hom (s.reduced K) N) ≪≫
            (finiteDerivedSections l E X n).mapIso (e.hom K N) ≪≫
            (finiteDerivedSections l E X n).mapIso
              ((coefficientFiniteInternalHom l E X n).mapIso
                (Iso.prod ((s.reductionEvaluation n).app K).symm.op (Iso.refl _))))
    let supportComparison := fun U : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E X ↦
      (restrictionEvaluation l E n).app (m.b U) ≪≫
        (finiteDerivedRestriction l E n).mapIso
          (e.sectionsY.derived.app (m.support.obj U) ≪≫
            (finiteDerivedSections l E Y n).mapIso ((supportEvaluation l E c n).app U))
    let reducedSupport := supportComparison (s.reduced K) ≪≫
      (finiteDerivedRestriction l E n).mapIso
        ((finiteDerivedSections l E Y n).mapIso
          ((finiteSupport l E c n).mapIso ((s.reductionEvaluation n).app K)))
    (coefHomPointEvaluation l E n).map (m.beta (s.reduced K) N) ≫
        (supportComparison N).hom =
      e.integral.derived.hom.app
          ((coefHomPointDerivedRestriction l E).obj (Model.h (s.reduced K) N),
            s.supportTower K) ≫
        e.finite.integralTensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom homComparison.hom reducedSupport.hom) ≫
        e.finite.beta ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).obj N)
